lines.text: The Lord GOD of Hosts will remove from Jerusalem and Judah the whole supply of food and water, and their leaders.
Mere lads will be their leaders, and the people will oppress one another, neighbor against neighbor.
A man seizes his brother in his father's house and says take charge of this heap of gold.
Jerusalem has stumbled and Judah has fallen because they acted against the LORD, and like Gomorrah they flaunt their sin.
The LORD stands to judge the people and charges the elders and leaders with devouring the vineyard and crushing the poor.
